checks.name: Pinned real README, complete bytes and independently observed hash
All real README H2 headings and source line positions
Five points, actions with unknown owners/deadlines, and exact source excerpts
Three real HTTP responses, including an intentional 404 control
Boundary anchor and all three headings in the actual Gmail HTML section
Real PR state, current-head check identities and independent review data
No delegation tool calls in the available current-run transcript excerpt
Follow-up source references: all 27 excerpts match their exact README lines
Real product responses, source hashes and changed-model redirect

limits: Exact excerpt matches do not establish semantic support for every clause; a human-readable review is required.
The original transcript export truncates long tool arguments/results. It ends before packaging and is not a complete execution trace.
No delegation was observed in the available excerpt; this does not prove unseen activity absent.
These supporting checks do not promote any case to a full workflow pass. Browser, login, writes and Routines require separate evidence.
